svg.text: PR #2208 · Key dashboard session state by portal connection
Dashboard state filed sessions by bare Uuid, unique only within one portal.
Now every set, map and callback uses SessionKey { conn, id }, so portals never collide.
BEFORE
AFTER
use_sessions -> Vec<SessionInfo>
Rows carry no portal; page actions build URLs with
utils::api_url and Request::delete / post.
DashboardSessionState: HashSet<Uuid>
awaiting, seen, hidden, connected, activated, focused_id;
rail maps, metrics, progress and SessionView callbacks
all keyed by the bare session id.
Same id from two portals = one merged entry
A linked portal echoing a home session id could share
its awaiting flag, focus or input route.
PortalSession { key, portal, info }
use_sessions fetches via use_portal(); delete, leave, stop
and pause go through the session's own PortalClient.
SessionKey { conn: ConnId, id } everywhere
Reducer, rail, sparkline, broadcast, keyboard nav, client
WS maps; SessionView keyed by SessionKey; rail dialogs
wrapped in the session's PortalClient context.
Only ConnId::HOME can log the page out
PortalClient::fetch_json ignores On401::Logout for any
other connection. Test: same id, two ConnIds, two entries.
localStorage formats unchanged; only home keys persist.
All sessions are still home, so behavior is unchanged. Persisted keys are not yet account-qualified, and ScheduleDialog still posts via utils.
